pick.headline: Operation Desert Storm air war begins
pick.summary: In the early hours of 17 January 1991, Baghdad time, US-led coalition aircraft and cruise missiles began attacking Iraq.
pick.significance: The air campaign opened the war to liberate Kuwait and displayed precision weapons and stealth aircraft to the world.

alternates.headline: Earthquake devastates Kobe
alternates.summary: On 17 January 1995 a magnitude 6.9 earthquake struck the Kobe region of Japan, killing more than 6,000 people.
alternates.significance: It was Japan's deadliest earthquake since 1923, and the slow official response shook confidence in the Japanese government.
